facts: Select front-side disks and run SST 12 hours under cold undervoltage.
Criterion only repeats setup; machine time is 240 minutes.
source_snapshot.v2: BLOCKED for missing bay map, workload and pass criteria.

original_test_intent.statement: Exercise all front-side storage for 12 hours at 0 C/-5% rails and detect device, data-path or platform instability.
must_preserve: All front bays, cold/undervoltage, 12 hours and storage health.
unknowns: Bay/drive identities, data safety, workload, acceptance, condensation procedure and duration conflict.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: Correctly prevents undefined disk I/O, but conflates current missing semantics with capability; qualified physical margin makes the eventual test MANUAL ONLY.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: No I/O may begin. Once safe targets/workload/criteria are supplied, software execution can be assisted but physical cold/undervoltage control remains manual.

revision_candidate.test_name: Stress All Front-Side Storage at 0 C and -5% Rail Margin
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the signed 12-hour workload against every approved front-side storage target under controlled cold undervoltage and verify data integrity, device health and clean platform logs.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact storage backplane/controller topology in a calibrated 0 C chamber with signed humidity/dew-point and condensation controls, plus owner-named -5% 5 V/3.3 V rails with defined control/measurement points, tolerances, soak, ramp and restoration sequence.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every physical front bay must have an owner-approved disposition: tested target, empty, or justified N/A. Tested bays are mapped to enclosure/slot/serial-or-WWN/controller/namespace and use only disposable or proven non-destructive targets; boot, production, mounted, swap, LVM, device-mapper and RAID members are excluded unless explicitly authorized.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Complete physical-bay manifest and disposition; stable device identities and ownership; boot/mount/swap/LVM/device-mapper/RAID classification; exact safe workload, I/O range, parallelism and end-to-end integrity method; performance/error thresholds; formal resolution that preserves the source 12-hour duration unless the case itself is revised; named rail points/tolerances, chamber humidity/dew-point/condensation/soak/ramp limits; monitoring cadence and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Perform read-only multi-view storage and environment inventory first. Only after signed resolution may the operator establish and verify the cold/undervoltage environment. Immediately before I/O, re-resolve each persistent serial/WWN/enclosure-slot identity, repeat protected-device interlocks and reject transient device-name-only targeting. Run the exact approved range/workload on every test disposition for the full 12 hours, retaining continuous environmental and per-target evidence without log clearing.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Every physical bay has a disposition; immediate identity and protected-use interlocks pass; backups/array policy, capacity/thermal margins, OOB, dew-point safeguards and controlled warm-up recovery are verified.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Complete physical-bay disposition; persistent physical/logical mapping and immediate pre-I/O interlocks; ownership and protected-use checks; command/version/range/parameters; full 12-hour per-target results and integrity proof; SMART/NVMe/SAS/controller/kernel/SEL deltas; continuous temperature, humidity/dew-point and named-rail traces; condensation observations, warm-up/restoration and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Every physical bay has a valid tested/empty/N/A disposition; every tested target completes the full 12-hour owner-defined integrity, zero-error and performance/health rules while environmental limits hold. Setup, inventory, workload launch, partial coverage or a 240-minute run is never completion.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No transient device-name targeting, guessed/raw/protected device, undefined or out-of-range write, omitted bay, log clearing, shortened run, moisture/dew-point exposure or remote fixture improvisation.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Storage owner approves every target/method; lab operator controls 0 C/-5% and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical environment is manual; bounded I/O may be automated only after per-device interlocks.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop I/O, preserve errors, warm and restore nominal rails, verify array/filesystem/device health and do not write to an uncertain target.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any undisposed bay, persistent-identity drift, protected-use interlock, ownership/range/acceptance ambiguity, unresolved duration, humidity/dew-point or named-rail definition failure, moisture, telemetry loss, medium/controller/integrity error, device loss, array/filesystem degradation, thermal/power/SEL anomaly, failed restoration or incomplete evidence.

reason_for_change: V3 preserves the absolute storage no-go until semantics are supplied while assigning the eventual capability according to the unavoidable manual cold/rail setup.
removed_ambiguities: Setup steps are not pass criteria; targets require stable physical/logical mapping.
resolved_blockers: Readiness is separated from MANUAL ONLY capability.
remaining_blockers: Bay map, safe workload and acceptance remain unresolved.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 does not relax the undefined-I/O prohibition, but it corrects the enduring classification, adds cold-condensation recovery and explicitly rejects the source's repeated setup steps as acceptance evidence.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Initial validation found incomplete all-bay disposition, pre-I/O identity/protected-device interlocks and cold/rail/dew-point controls. Revalidation confirmed every-bay disposition, persistent identity, full 12-hour coverage and complete manual environmental safeguards.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 54 is all front-side storage at 0 C/-5%, 12-hour SST, but the criterion only repeats procedure steps.
